# Oral Surgery, Instruments

**Authors:** Karishma Bhatia, Glenda Aruede

**Source:** StatPearls - StatPearls Publishing

## Abstract

Numerous instruments are utilized during oral surgical procedures, each having a specific role (see Image. An Oral Surgery Instruments Kit). Dental practitioners should be able to select appropriate instruments in given situations, preventing iatrogenic damage and traumatic procedures and thus increasing patient safety. This article introduces several commonly used instruments during various oral surgical procedures but does not provide an exhaustive list.
